thread:
Maya K: quick heads-up — PR #8123 is blocked on an architecture signal. We don't have a full RFC yet; can we get a lightweight RFC link or an arch blessing so we can schedule a canary? PR: https://git.company/redwood/pr/8123 :wave:
Jason L: can you paste the minimal changes and the rollout plan here? we can probably do a short RFC that just covers safety/rollback and SLO delta.
Maya K: sure — diff is small (routing + a feature flag). rollout proposal:
```
canary: 5% traffic -> 30m monitor -> 25% -> 2h monitor -> full
metrics: latency p95, error-rate, token-cost delta
rollback: flip feature flag, fallback to model-v1 route
```
Anika S: that looks fine. please add a one-page RFC link that states motivation, compatibility, and the fallback flows. no need for deep perf numbers. I can eyeball it quickly.
Rob T: quick Q on SLOs — do we expect any p75/p95 shift? if so call it out. also confirm we have alerts for the canary window.
Maya K: expecting minor p95 bump (~5ms) due to extra routing hop; added alert for p95 > baseline + 15ms and error-rate > 0.5% over 10m. will add those to the RFC.
Jason L: pinging infra for arch eyes @Anika S @Rob T — can you give a +1 on a minimal RFC (a single md file) to unblock merge? :pray:
Anika S: +1 for the minimal RFC as long as rollback and alerts are explicit.
Rob T: +1 if the alert thresholds are in the doc. note: coordinate with oncall for the 2h monitor window.
Maya K: thanks — I'll post the RFC link in this thread in ~20m and re-tag.
deploy-bot: ci/cd: build passed for PR #8123 — all checks green :white_check_mark:
Maya K: RFC posted: https://docs.company/redwood/rfcs/XXXX-minimal-routing-change — requesting final arch blessing so we can merge during next release slot (tomorrow 10:00-12:00).
Jason L: acked — I'll queue the canary and monitor.
Anika S: gave formal +1 in the RFC thread. go ahead after you confirm oncall.
Rob T: noted. oncall confirmed availability for the window. good to merge after a PR approval from ownership. :thumbsup:
